concerns.location: tasks.md:Completed work / coverage table vs spec.md:FR-009(c)
concerns.text: FR-009(c) requires correlating the interaction-energy error with viscosity, but plan.md Phase 3 'explicitly excludes' that correlation and the completed-work bullet for correlate_bulk.py claims FR-009 coverage without stating which of the three FR-009 correlation families were computed. No open task closes this gap, so FR-009(c) has no verifiable matcher. Either add a task computing it or record the spec deviation explicitly.

SC-005 requires completion within 6 hours and ≤7 GB RAM, but T067's verification only records 'commands, exit codes, and artifact checksums'. No task measures or records wall-clock runtime or peak memory, so SC-005's measurable outcome has no evidence-producing task. Extend T067 to capture runtime and peak RSS.

T067 validates contracts against 'specs/001-transferability-of-dft-d3-dispersion-to-/contracts/' while plan.md places artifacts under 'specs/PROJ-735-transferability-of-dft-d3-dispersion-to-/'. The path mismatch means the verification step may validate the wrong (or nonexistent) directory. Align the path.

Canonical artifact paths are inconsistent within tasks.md: T065 cites 'data/derived/scaling_factor.txt' while the completed-work section lists bare 'scaling_factor.txt'; T068 references both 'data/derived/scaling_factor.txt' and unprefixed 'correlation_results.csv' in the same sentence. Pick one canonical path per artifact so verification is unambiguous.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage table vs spec.md:Requirements
concerns.text: Spec numbering jumps FR-012→FR-014 and SC-003→SC-005 with no removal record; the coverage table cannot account for FR-013/SC-004. If intentionally deleted, note it; otherwise the coverage table is incomplete relative to the spec's ID space.
